'''Jan Lužný''' (4 February 1926{{snd}}29 January 2013) was a [[Czech Republic|Czech]] [[Plant breeder|plant-breeder]] and expert on [[gardening]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.zahradaweb.cz/informace-z-oboru/vyroci/Prof.-Ing.-Jan-Luzny-CSc.-nestarnouci-nestor-zahradnictvi__s1584x56584.html |archive-url=https://archive.today/20130412055331/http://www.zahradaweb.cz/informace-z-oboru/vyroci/Prof.-Ing.-Jan-Luzny-CSc.-nestarnouci-nestor-zahradnictvi__s1584x56584.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=12 April 2013 |title=Prof. Ing. Jan Lužný, CSc., nestárnoucí nestor zahradnictví |last=Salaš |first=Petr |publisher=zahradaweb.cz |access-date=13 March 2013 }}</ref><ref>{{Citation|last = Řezníček|first = Vojtěch|last2 = Salaš|first2 = Petr|last3 = Lužný|first3 = Jan|title = České osobnosti výzkumu a šlechtění okrasných, ovocných rostlin a révy vinné ve XX. století|place = Brno|publisher = Mendelova zemědělská a lesnická univerzita|year = 2002|edition = 1st|page = 174|isbn = 80-7157-637-9}}</ref> Between 1965 and 1992, he gave lectures at the [[Mendel University in Brno|University of Agriculture in Brno]].<ref>{{Citation|last=Jakábová |first=A. |last2=Hričovský |first2=I. |title=K životnému jubileu prof. Ing. Jana Lužného, CSc. |date=February 13, 2006 |url=http://www.zahradaweb.cz/informace-z-oboru/zpravodajstvi/K-zivotnemu-jubileu-prof.-Ing.-Jana-Luzneho-CSc.__s520x43869.html|archive-url=https://archive.today/20130412060244/http://www.zahradaweb.cz/informace-z-oboru/zpravodajstvi/K-zivotnemu-jubileu-prof.-Ing.-Jana-Luzneho-CSc.__s520x43869.html|url-status=dead|archive-date=April 12, 2013|access-date=27 March 2013 }}</ref> He wrote more than 70 papers about plant-breeding. After his retirement, he became an amateur historian and published many articles about local history of [[Čechůvky]].<ref>{{cite news|last = Bartková|first = Hana|title = Zemřel Jan Lužný – čechůvský patriot a přední zahradnický odborník|newspaper = Radniční listy|location = Prostějov|page= 28|date = 27 February 2013}}</ref>

== Works ==
* ''[[EUCARPIA]] breeding and propagation of ornamental plants:'' papers submitted at the International Symposium of the University of Agriculture Brno, Faculty of Horticulture Lednice na Moravě, Prague September 16.-18.1986. Brno: University of Agriculture, 1986. 194 pp.
* ''Use of epispermoscopic analysis in seed assessment.'' [Brno], 1982.

== Honors and awards ==
* G. J. Mendel honorary medal for merit in the biological sciences (2006)
